note: Controlled benchmark of the engine at commit bc7de0c (v0.9.0 plus brand-tinted paper surfaces on the light styles, features[].art object fix, florist category, selector and snippet on gate issues, RTL support). Haiku 5.5 without vs with the MCP, identical SPEC.md, same 60-call budget, four never-seen domains (ironbark tree surgeons, formwell forms software, harvest catering, driftwood kayak hire), engine frozen for the run. RESULT: engine 0/8, judged more template-like in 8/8; engine originality 4.9 and colour 5.75, the lowest of any run. The brand-tinted surfaces BACKFIRED: with the agents' green accents the whole page became mint, and judges called the engine pages a 'mint-green SaaS template' and 'mint-on-mint', while the baselines' 'warm cream, forest and amber' palettes won; the tinting is therefore reverted to opt-in. All four MCP agents patched the style to the older field-notes or warm-human, so the new styles were not exercised. The spec forbids external images for both arms, so the photo, logo-prompt and placeholder tools were not exercised. COST: engine arm tokens 113k-134k vs baseline 100k-111k, tool calls 17-32 vs 12-21, time 246-310 s vs 192-244 s. DEFECTS named by agents (to fix): the matcher first chose the loud neo-brutal style for a relaxed outdoor hire brand; brief_template returns the generic SaaS template for food and outdoor-activity categories; a decorative hero icon tile rendered blank (a missing icon). CONFOUNDS: several agents deleted their own scratch files; one agent made an unnecessary read_documentation call. NOT deployed to Vercel (no VERCEL_TOKEN in this environment).
